title: Imperial bedroom
goal: A reader must be able to verify a tightly planned bedroom measuring exactly seven by nine feet.

rubric.must: The exterior dimension strings visibly read 7'0" and 9'0".
A bed and wardrobe are both visible inside the labeled bedroom.
The inward door swing is clear of the bed and wardrobe.
A window is visibly centered on the wall opposite the entry door.
Visible clear floor space permits access from the door to the bed and wardrobe.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG meets both blockers and shows unobstructed access, a clear inward door swing, and a centered window opposite the entry.
